title: Interpretations, Representations, and Stereotypes of Caste within Text-to-Image Generators

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images with Stable Diffusion using prompts that explicitly mention different castes (e.g., Brahmin, Dalit, high-caste, low-caste) alongside baseline prompts ('Indian person') and occupational variations ('at work'). The outputs are then evaluated using CLIP-cosine similarity to measure visual divergence from the baseline, supplemented by manual qualitative analysis to identify embedded visual stereotypes (such as manual labor, poverty, or protests).
